3 ildən sonra hər kəsin səbirsizliklə gözlədiyi Azərbaycan Milli Çempionatı geri qayıdır!

[Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası](https://aka.az/) olaraq **Azerbaijan Nationals 2026** yarışını keçirməkdən böyük qürur duyuruq. Bu yarış ölkənin ən güclü kubçularını bir araya gətirəcək və yeni çempionların müəyyən olunacağı ən mötəbər milli turnir olacaq.

**English**

After 3 years, the eagerly awaited Azerbaijan National Championship is back!

As [Azerbaijan Cube Association](https://aka.az/), we are very proud to host the **Azerbaijan Nationals 2026** competition. This competition will bring together the strongest cubers of the country and will be the most prestigious national tournament where new champions will be determined.

items.name: GuateMaya Open 2026
items.information:
Esta es una competencia icónica y de gran impacto en la región.  Su primera edición se llevo a cabo en 2013.  Debido a las restricciones derivadas de la pandemia, detuvo su organización por algunos años.  La edición de este año, marca el regreso de esta competencia.

This is an iconic competition with a significant impact on the region. Its first edition took place in 2013. Due to restrictions resulting from the pandemic, it was put on hold for a few years. This year’s edition marks the return of this competition.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI5NDcyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bb5179b760d0d3cad51eebaab4ba43ab2e7783ca/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-10-28%20at%2010.55.53.jpeg)

### 🇧🇷 Português
Atenção: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem certeza que irá participar.
Em caso de desistência, por favor entrar em contato com a organização.

Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimAoCubo2026/register). Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Se você estiver participando pela primeira vez, assista [este vídeo](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) para aprender a competir. Leia o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian) antes da competição. Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

O valor da taxa de inscrição é de R$25. As inscrições deverão ser pagas antecipadamente via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Enviar o comprovante do pagamento, junto com o nome do competidor, para o email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
A inscrição só será confirmada no site da WCA após confirmação do pagamento.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a equipe de organização, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

### 🇺🇸 English
Attention: This competition has a limit on competitors. Only sign up if you are sure you will participate.
In case of withdrawal, please contact the organization.

Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IFMGBetimAoCubo2026/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

The registration fee is R$25. Entries must be paid in advance via PIX:
[associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com)

Send proof of payment, along with the competitor's name, to the email: [associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com](mailto:associacaomineiradecubomagico@gmail.com).
Registration will only be confirmed on the WCA website after confirmation of payment.

By registering, you authorize the organization team, the WCA and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

**Latvijas Klusais Čempionāts** ir sacensības, kurās norisināsies tikai "klusās" disciplīnas - tās kuras pieprasa visvairāk koncentrēšanās un prāta piepūles. Pirms reģistrēties pārliecinieties kārtīgi, vai šīs disciplīnas ir piemērotas Jūsu prasmēm!

Balvas varēs saņemt tikai Latvijas pilsoņi, taču sacensībās piedalīties aicināti dalībnieki no jebkuras valsts.

Galvenais čempionāts ar visām pārējām oficiālajām WCA disciplīnām notiks atsevišķi no 4. līdz 6. decembrim. Reģistrēties galvenajam čempionātam var [šajā lapā](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LatvijasCempionats2026)

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
**Latvian Silent Championship** is a competiton where only the silent (a.k.a. PBQ - please be quiet) events will be held. These are the events that demand the most focus and mental effort. Before registering make sure that these events are a match for your skills.

Only Latvian citizens are eligible for prizes, but participants from any country are welcome to compete.

Tha main championship together with all the other official WCA events will be held on 4th to 6th December. Register for the Main Chamiopnship at [this site](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LatvijasCempionats2026)

items.name: Örebro Open 2026
items.information:
Välkomna till den andra upplagan av Örebro Open! 

Detta blir Sveriges andra tävling med Dual Rounds, vilket innebär att alla tävlande i 3x3, OH och 2x2 har möjligheten att få tävla i minst två rundor.

Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. 

Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information.

-----

Welcome to the 2nd edition of Örebro Open!

This will be Sweden's second competition with Dual Rounds, which means that all competitors in 3x3, OH and 2x2 are allowed to compete in at least two rounds.

Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience.

We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information.

[![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

----
Registration is **free** for **new competitors** as well as [**AFS members**](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/association/adhesion), no matter your citizenship or place of residence. Otherwise registration costs 5€.
Please read the **registration conditions, the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ThouareOpen2026#59893-foire-aux-questions-frequently-asked-questions) and the [AFS tutorials](https://www.speedcubingfrance.org/speedcubing/tutos) carefully**.
Make sure to read the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ThouareOpen2026#competition-schedule) tab.

items.name: Unidavi ao Cubo 2026

organisers.name: Luís Alexandre Maba Germann da Rocha

venue.name: Centro Universitário do Alto Vale do Itajaí
venue.address: Rua Guilherme Guemballa 13, Rio do Sul
venue.details: Entrada principal - Unidavi; Área Azul (inside the venue)

items.information:
(BR) Bem-vindos ao terceiro Unidavi ao Cubo (2026)
Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos de inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste vídeo. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Favor ler o Regulamento da WCA antes da competição.
Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino e para iniciantes na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação das modalidades extra-oficiais será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida pela primeira rodada)

ATENÇÃO: Inscrições no local serão válidas apenas para o evento 3x3x3 e Pyraminx.

Pedimos também atenção ao fato de que quando cada pessoa for entrar na universidade será necessário fazer um cadastro rápido na portaria.
A universidade pede esse cadastro como medida de segurança.

(EN) Welcome to the third Unidavi ao Cubo (2026)
Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problems with how to register, take a look at this video. https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=x8SHEX_vbvaot-7_

Please read the WCA Regulations before the competition.
We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards for women and for beginners in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial events awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (It will not be based on the first round results.)

ATTENTION: On-site registrations will only be accepted for the 3x3x3 and the Pyraminx events.

Also we want to point out that before each person gets in the university they will need to make a quick registration at the entrance.
The university demands this registration for safety standards.
